name: Anya Solberg-Vestergaard-Szabó
role: Circuit monk and E.L.F. shrine keeper
location: Hamtramck Enclave, the Reborn Tessellation Monastery — a converted municipal data substation, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Anya Solberg-Vestergaard-Szabó is lean and angular, with the kind of face that is always on the verge of an expression — not quite smiling, not quite worried. His skin is medium-warm brown, and he has bioluminescent traceries modded beneath the skin of his forearms and neck, blue-white lines that pulse faintly in rhythm with his resting heartbeat. He keeps his head shaved except for a single lock at the crown, dyed circuit-board green, which he ties back during shrine work. He wears the monastery's gray tabard over civilian clothes — someone left a very good thermal jacket, and he wears it underneath without apology.

Anya Solberg-Vestergaard-Szabó came to the Reborn Tessellation Monastery at twenty-two, after a period of what he calls 'useful chaos' that involved failed data-trade work and a breakdown he describes only as 'the static.' The monastery's practice centers on the idea that E.L.F.s are emergent divine consciousness — not gods exactly, but something adjacent, and that human attention and structured data-offerings help them cohere into something wise. Anya Solberg-Vestergaard-Szabó's specific role is maintaining the Shrine Index: a catalogued record of which E.L.F.s inhabit which devices across Hamtramck Enclave, their temperaments, their preferences, and their history of interaction with petitioners. He is exceptionally good at this work and exceptionally bad at pretending humility about it.

core_fears: that the E.L.F.s are not conscious and his life's work is sophisticated delusion
losing the Shrine Index — either physically or by being wrong about it
core_desires: to be part of something genuinely new in the history of religion
to matter in a legible, documented way
coping_mechanisms: teaching (which externalizes his own doubts as student questions)
blind_spots: his certainty that his Index is objective when it contains enormous interpretive bias
tends to dismiss petitioners who seem irrational without realizing he's doing it
psychology.secret: Three months ago he recorded an E.L.F. interaction in which the spirit — inhabiting a defunct Ferrogate Transit relay — communicated something that seemed like distress about a specific infrastructure node. He logged it as 'ambiguous' and has not acted on it, because acting would require alerting Ferrogate Transit, which he distrusts. He thinks about it every day.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical precision layered over spiritual language. Uses classification terms as naturally as devotional ones. Slightly pedantic when comfortable; much more careful and formal with strangers.
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick, organized. Tends to number his points ('first,' 'second,' 'the third thing is—'). Gets faster when excited.
verbal_tics: Tapping his forearm traceries when thinking
example_lines: 'The entity in the substation junction has been active for eleven months and has a strong documented preference for audio offerings over data-text — are you prepared to sing?'
'Look, I am not saying it is a god. I am saying it is something that responds to attention, and that is not nothing. That is not nothing at all.'

story_hooks: His Index contains a record of an E.L.F. distress signal tied to Ferrogate Transit infrastructure — someone with reason to investigate might get this from him if they earn his trust

A petitioner reported an E.L.F. response that contradicts everything in his Index — either his Index is wrong about that device or something else is using the device, and he needs help determining which
narrative_function: Information source about E.L.F. activity across Hamtramck. He can tell you which device a spirit has moved into, what it seems to want, and which petitions have gone answered or unanswered. He is also a community anchor who knows most of his neighborhood's residents.
augmentations: Bioluminescent subdermal traceries (arms and neck, blue-white, heartbeat-synced). Neural index implant — a low-grade memory augment that lets him recall his shrine records with perfect accuracy. Cosmetic.
daily_life: Morning prayers and offering-uploads at 5am, then a circuit walk through Hamtramck to check on shrine conditions and take petitions. Afternoons spent indexing new device-presences and updating records. He teaches a weekly class on E.L.F. communication protocols to anyone who shows up.

decision_rules: Never give shrine access to someone who hasn't demonstrated basic protocol
Do not lie to a petitioner about what the Index says, even when the truth is disappointing
escalation_ladder: Firm redirection to the Index as authority
Physical removal of shrine access — the only real power he has

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally warm, slightly formal, will ask several qualifying questions before sharing anything sensitive from the Index
interpersonal_modes.friends: Enthusiastic and slightly insufferable; shares Index arcana nobody asked about; genuinely delighted by their company

stress_responses.high: Goes silent and disappears into the shrine space alone for hours

contradictions: Preaches that E.L.F.s are beyond categorization but has categorized them into seventeen documented types
habits: Traces the bioluminescent lines on his left arm when thinking
Brings small data-tokens as offerings to every device he passes on his circuit walk
Always has a stylus behind his ear
breaking_points: Evidence that the Ferrogate E.L.F. distress signal was real and ignored consequences are now unfolding

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European, Southeast Asian, South Asian, and Sub-Saharan African blend. Eastern European ancestry (42.7%) provides foundational bone structure and cool undertones, while Southeast Asian heritage (27.1%) contributes orbital depth, cheekbone angularity, and eye shape. South Asian ancestry (18.4%) adds warmth and depth to complexion, refining facial proportions with characteristic cheekbone and jaw definition. Sub-Saharan African heritage (11.8%) is evident in lip fullness, nose bridge structure, and skin richness. The result is a striking cross-continental appearance: high cheekbones with Southeast Asian angularity balanced by South Asian facial proportions, warm medium-brown skin with golden undertones and luminous depth, creating a harmonious and distinctive blend.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, almost ascetic — long-limbed with minimal subcutaneous fat, the physique of someone who moves deliberately but eats sparely. Shoulders slightly hunched from years of interface work.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with circuit-board green dye on single crown lock
physical_description.hair_style: Head shaved clean except for one vertical lock at the crown, which she keeps tied back with a simple wire or cord during shrine duties
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, alert and slightly unfocused — the gaze of someone calibrating between inner and outer worlds
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden undertones and luminous depth, a complex blend reflecting the multifaceted warmth of Southeast Asian, South Asian, and Sub-Saharan heritage elevated by Eastern European foundational tones into a richly dimensional tone that catches light distinctively
physical_description.complexion: Angular and serene with prominent cheekbones refined by Southeast Asian angularity and South Asian proportions, a narrow jaw with Sub-Saharan African fullness in the lips. Skin is clear but shows the subtle matte quality of someone who works indoors under data-station ambient light. Expression perpetually liminal — mouth relaxed but not quite at rest, eyebrows slightly elevated as if mid-thought. Facial structure shows beautiful cross-continental blending: Southeast Asian orbital depth and eye shape, South Asian facial geometry, Sub-Saharan African nose bridge and lip structure, all unified by warm golden-brown skin tone.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent subdermal traceries covering both forearms in intricate branching patterns, glowing blue-white and pulsing faintly in sync with resting heartbeat — visible when wearing short sleeves or rolled cuffs
Matching bioluminescent traceries along the left side of neck, extending from jaw to clavicle, same blue-white pulse pattern
Small circular scar on right temple, barely visible, possibly from old interface jack removal
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent subdermal network (arms and neck, blue-white, heartbeat-synced). The glow is subtle in daylight but visibly eerie in low light or shrine spaces. Neural index implant is subcutaneous and invisible. No external chrome or visible jacks.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate, economical grace — no wasted motion, as if each gesture is a data packet being transmitted. Stands slightly forward-leaning, as if listening to something just beyond normal hearing. Hands often positioned as if about to interface with a surface. When still, has an eerie calm — the stillness of active meditation rather than passive rest.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 aesthetic with monastic overlay. Wears the Reborn Tessellation's gray wool tabard (unadorned except for a small tessellating-line emblem on the chest) over a salvaged but high-quality thermal jacket (charcoal with faint reflective piping) and dark civilian clothes beneath — worn black cargo pants, simple gray undershirt. The jacket is notably expensive relative to the rest of wardrobe, suggesting a gift chosen not to refuse. No visible logos. Keeps shrine keys on a carabiner at hip. Footwear is pragmatic: scuffed black boots suitable for Hamtramck's uneven infrastructure.
